name: Pension-Ferienwohnungen Inntal
beschreibung:
History

On its own website the house is called Gästehaus Inntal. It is run by the Gründler family, address Tafang 35, 6341 Ebbs. A founding year, a builder or a house chronicle is not published there. What is documented is the present form: a family-run guesthouse with comfort rooms in Tiroler Landhausstil and holiday apartments. The older designation Pension-Ferienwohnungen Inntal means the same business under haus-inntal.com. The house should not be confused with other Inntal guesthouses outside Ebbs.

Getting there

The page Lage und Anreise describes a vignette-free drive from Germany via the Inntalautobahn, exit Oberaudorf, or via the motorway A8 München–Salzburg, exit Frasdorf, then via Aschau, Sachrang and Niederndorferberg to Ebbs. From the direction of Innsbruck the same page names the exit Kufstein Nord. By train the stations Oberaudorf and Kufstein are given. From Oberaudorf the house reckons about 10 kilometres by taxi to Ebbs, from Kufstein about 10 kilometres by Postbus or taxi. A bus stop, which is also described as a ski-bus stop, lies according to the page near the house. As airports the house names Innsbruck at about 90 kilometres, Salzburg at about 90 kilometres and München at about 110 kilometres. The house has its own parking spaces. Telephone and fax are +43 5373 42279, email info@haus-inntal.com.

Tips

The house describes its location as central, near the Fohlenhof Ebbs and the local recreation area around the Zahmer Kaiser and on numerous cycling and hiking paths. It also points out that the guesthouse lies conveniently for a stopover on the journey to the south or back. The comfort rooms have shower and WC, for the most part a balcony, plus satellite television and Wi-Fi at no charge. Holiday apartments are listed for 4 to 7 people, with balcony and a view towards the Kaisergebirge. In addition there is a breakfast and lounge room with satellite television, a covered arbour and Wi-Fi throughout the house. Breakfast is described as extended and served predominantly with products from the region.

The price page names an overnight stay with breakfast in a double room from 30 euros per person per day. Holiday apartments for 2 to 6 people start there from 60 euros per day. The local tax is 3.50 euros per person per day. Final cleaning of a holiday apartment is charged at 25 to 50 euros per stay, a dog at 5 euros per day. According to the house, payment is in cash only, not by EC card. Reserved rooms and holiday apartments can be cancelled free of charge up to one week before arrival; after that the full rental price is charged. A reservation is valid only after an enquiry and confirmation. A child discount is available on request. Prices depend on the season and the length of stay.
kurzbeschreibung: Family-run guesthouse of the Gründler family in Ebbs, with comfort rooms, holiday apartments and breakfast, near the Fohlenhof and the Zahmer Kaiser.
